## What problem should this feature solve?

Describe the problem, limitation, or use-case (e.g. new type of report, new analysis step, new lab exercise).

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you would like to see.

- What should it do?
- How should it be used (CLI, notebook, GitHub Actions, etc.)?

## Alternatives considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Affected area

- [ ] Audio / fonoscopy tools
- [ ] Digital evidence / case repository
- [ ] Building / technical audit tools
- [ ] GitHub Actions / automation
- [ ] Documentation / README / labs

## Additional context

Links, sketches, pseudo-code, or references that help understand the proposal.
